changelog.summary: Promotes the workflow guide to a chat-led Engineering Operations Analyst to Delivery Coordinator proposal with typed metric/action handoff, pending setup and executable contract checks.
Combines engineering data foundation, delivery/quality/reliability intelligence, and recurring operations review into one small-team workflow playbook.

title: Engineering Operations Intelligence
description: Reconcile one governed team engineering metric, then prepare an owned improvement review with current issue evidence.
setup_prompt: Use Engineering Operations Intelligence as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Engineering Operations Analyst and Engineering Delivery Coordinator Crews, authorized source exports, exact team/service, versioned metric rule, equal-window policy, coverage and current issue state. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, blocking validators, one manual case, a bounded owner question and a later independent observation. Preserve the data-model guidance. Selecting the Playbook does not create issues, message a team or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Team, repositories, services, environments, and authorized engineering sources
History, freshness, timezone, identity, and workflow-state mappings
Engineering goals, metric definitions, targets, exclusions, and data-quality minimums
Review audience, cadence, comparison window, and required sections
Action owners, approval policy, delivery destinations, and notification conditions
Retention, restricted fields, access policy, and source-of-truth precedence

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether the intelligence supports the team's important engineering decisions
Actionability, unintended incentives, operating cost, and measured outcomes
review_when: Outcomes regress, priorities change, or recurring reviews stop producing useful actions

outputs: Reviewed Crew roster and source/metric policy map
Validated engineering-metric-observation/v1 with coverage and comparable state
Validated engineering-improvement-review/v1 with current owner and issue state
Manual case, later observation rule, blockers and activation choice
